units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|name|224|0
units.english: Seek help from the Incipias
units.italian: Cerca aiuto dagli Incipias

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|description|225|0
units.english: Ask the Incipias for help to save one of their ships.
units.italian: Chiedi aiuto agli Incipias per salvare una delle loro navi.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|Would you like to ask the Quarg for insight on your strange encounter with the stranded alien ship?|233|0
units.english: Would you like to ask the Quarg for insight on your strange encounter with the stranded alien ship?
units.italian: Vuoi chiedere ai Quarg un parere sul tuo strano incontro con la nave aliena bloccata?

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	(Yes.)|235|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	(Not right now.)|236|0
units.english: (Not right now.)
units.italian: (Non ora.)

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	Right after you arrive on the planet, you search for a Quarg who speaks your language so that you can tell them about the stranded ship you found. One of the Quarg seems to understand your intention and gestures for you to wait. It returns a few moments later accompanied by the same Quarg you talked to before.|238|0
units.english: Right after you arrive on the planet, you search for a Quarg who speaks your language so that you can tell them about the stranded ship you found. One of the Quarg seems to understand your intention and gestures for you to wait. It returns a few moments later accompanied by the same Quarg you talked to before.
units.italian: Appena arrivi sul pianeta cerchi un Quarg che parli la tua lingua, per raccontargli della nave bloccata che hai trovato. Uno dei Quarg sembra capire la tua intenzione e ti fa cenno di aspettare. Torna poco dopo accompagnato dallo stesso Quarg con cui avevi parlato prima.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"Human, you seem to be in quite a haste. What could be such a pressing matter?" it asks.|239|0
units.english: "Human, you seem to be in quite a haste. What could be such a pressing matter?" it asks.
units.italian: "Umano, sembri avere una certa fretta. Quale questione può essere così urgente?", chiede.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	(Explain the situation.)|241|0
units.english: (Explain the situation.)
units.italian: (Spiega la situazione.)

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"I need advice regarding the species in this region."|243|0
units.english: "I need advice regarding the species in this region."
units.italian: "Ho bisogno di un consiglio sulla specie di questa regione."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	It looks at you curiously. "So you have held council with the young Incipias? This one is nonplussed that you ably formed correspondence. It took a prolonged period of time even for us to decipher their way of dissemination."|244|0
units.english: It looks at you curiously. "So you have held council with the young Incipias? This one is nonplussed that you ably formed correspondence. It took a prolonged period of time even for us to decipher their way of dissemination."
units.italian: Ti guarda con curiosità. "Dunque hai tenuto consiglio con i giovani Incipias? Questo uno resta perplesso che tu abbia saputo stabilire un contatto. Ci è voluto un lungo periodo anche a noi per decifrare il loro modo di diffondere i messaggi."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	You quickly explain what happened. From what you can tell, the Quarg seems relieved that you were not able to talk to them.|245|0
units.english: You quickly explain what happened. From what you can tell, the Quarg seems relieved that you were not able to talk to them.
units.italian: Spieghi in fretta cos'è successo. Da quel che capisci, il Quarg sembra sollevato che tu non sia riuscito a parlare con loro.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"You ran into a most peculiar situation. Surpassing the borders of their system is not yet a capability possessed by the Incipias." It tilts its head for a moment, considering what you just said. "It is our desire to help them, but it is yet premature for us to reveal ourselves to their species, and certainly premature for them to be interacting with independent interlopers such as yourself. I fear that we are impotent in this unfortunate turn of events."|247|0
units.english: "You ran into a most peculiar situation. Surpassing the borders of their system is not yet a capability possessed by the Incipias." It tilts its head for a moment, considering what you just said. "It is our desire to help them, but it is yet premature for us to reveal ourselves to their species, and certainly premature for them to be interacting with independent interlopers such as yourself. I fear that we are impotent in this unfortunate turn of events."
units.italian: "Ti sei imbattuto in una situazione assai singolare. Superare i confini del loro sistema non è ancora una capacità degli Incipias." Inclina la testa per un momento, considerando quello che hai appena detto. "È nostro desiderio aiutarli, ma è ancora prematuro per noi rivelarci alla loro specie, e certo prematuro che loro interagiscano con intrusi indipendenti come te. Temo che siamo impotenti di fronte a questo infelice corso degli eventi."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"I could help them."|249|0
units.english: "I could help them."
units.italian: "Potrei aiutarli io."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"How can you make such a cold-hearted decision?"|250|0
units.english: "How can you make such a cold-hearted decision?"
units.italian: "Come puoi prendere una decisione così insensibile?"

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"I understand. I'll leave them alone."|252|0
units.english: "I understand. I'll leave them alone."
units.italian: "Capisco. Li lascerò in pace."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"You lack the tools for such a mission. To this one's knowledge, no vessels capable of landing on gas giants have ever been developed by your kind. And you are certainly not able to make your intentions known to them in any meaningful sense." The Quarg stares at you for a moment, pondering a little.|255|0
units.english: "You lack the tools for such a mission. To this one's knowledge, no vessels capable of landing on gas giants have ever been developed by your kind. And you are certainly not able to make your intentions known to them in any meaningful sense." The Quarg stares at you for a moment, pondering a little.
units.italian: "Ti mancano gli strumenti per una simile missione. Per quanto ne sa questo uno, nessun vascello in grado di atterrare su un gigante gassoso è mai stato sviluppato dalla tua specie. E certo non sei in grado di farti capire da loro in alcun modo significativo." Il Quarg ti fissa per un momento, riflettendo un poco.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"But for the sake of the Incipias, this one will assist you on this last point. If you cannot be dissuaded from your course of action, then it is best you are supplied a means of communication, so that your interactions may be on amicable terms. This one can produce you with a single one of our translators, which will allow you to relate your intentions to the species. Request that they sell you one of their ships, so that you are made capable to land on their tumultuous planets."|256|0
units.english: "But for the sake of the Incipias, this one will assist you on this last point. If you cannot be dissuaded from your course of action, then it is best you are supplied a means of communication, so that your interactions may be on amicable terms. This one can produce you with a single one of our translators, which will allow you to relate your intentions to the species. Request that they sell you one of their ships, so that you are made capable to land on their tumultuous planets."
units.italian: "Ma per il bene degli Incipias, questo uno ti assisterà su quest'ultimo punto. Se non si può dissuaderti dal tuo corso d'azione, è meglio che ti sia fornito un mezzo di comunicazione, così che le tue interazioni possano avvenire su termini amichevoli. Questo uno può procurarti uno solo dei nostri traduttori, che ti permetterà di esporre le tue intenzioni alla specie. Chiedi che ti vendano una delle loro navi, così da essere in grado di atterrare sui loro pianeti turbolenti."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	It pauses before taking on a more serious tone. "However, you are forbidden from granting the young species any advanced technology of yours. If you concur with us on that point, we shall furnish you with a translator."|257|0
units.english: It pauses before taking on a more serious tone. "However, you are forbidden from granting the young species any advanced technology of yours. If you concur with us on that point, we shall furnish you with a translator."
units.italian: Fa una pausa prima di assumere un tono più serio. "Tuttavia, ti è vietato concedere alla giovane specie qualsiasi tecnologia avanzata che sia tua. Se sei d'accordo con noi su questo punto, ti forniremo un traduttore."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"If that's how I can help them, sure."|259|0
units.english: "If that's how I can help them, sure."
units.italian: "Se è così che posso aiutarli, d'accordo."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"Why do you not want me to give them my tech?"|261|0
units.english: "Why do you not want me to give them my tech?"
units.italian: "Perché non vuoi che dia loro la mia tecnologia?"

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"Halting the natural increase of a species is unpredictable at the best of times. Your species lacks the wisdom to understand this, as you are young, and have not seen what we have seen." The Quarg pauses for a moment, lost in thought. "The foreseeable risks of even letting you contact them are monumental, and not something you should consider trivial."|262|0
units.english: "Halting the natural increase of a species is unpredictable at the best of times. Your species lacks the wisdom to understand this, as you are young, and have not seen what we have seen." The Quarg pauses for a moment, lost in thought. "The foreseeable risks of even letting you contact them are monumental, and not something you should consider trivial."
units.italian: "Fermare il naturale accrescimento di una specie è imprevedibile, nel migliore dei casi. Alla tua specie manca la saggezza per capirlo, perché siete giovani e non avete visto quello che abbiamo visto noi." Il Quarg tace per un momento, perso nei pensieri. "I rischi prevedibili anche del solo lasciarti comunicare con loro sono enormi, e non è qualcosa che tu debba considerare banale."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"I will accept your conditions to help them."|264|0
units.english: "I will accept your conditions to help them."
units.italian: "Accetterò le tue condizioni per aiutarli."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"The risks do sound concerning. I will leave them alone after all."|265|0
units.english: "The risks do sound concerning. I will leave them alone after all."
units.italian: "I rischi sembrano preoccupanti. Dopo tutto li lascerò in pace."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|log|270|0
units.english: Discovered that the species to the northeast of Hai space, the Incipias, are under the protection of the Quarg. Was given a translator by a Quarg in order to assist a stranded Incipias ship, but was warned not to give the Incipias any advanced technology or interfere in their development.
units.italian: Scoperto che la specie a nord-est dello spazio degli Hai, gli Incipias, è sotto la protezione dei Quarg. Ricevuto un traduttore da un Quarg per assistere una nave Incipias bloccata, ma avvertito di non dare agli Incipias alcuna tecnologia avanzata né di interferire nel loro sviluppo.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"Happy this one is that you agree to that condition. Bear in mind, Captain, that the slightest misstep may have grave consequences." The Quarg stares you down. "We will be watching your actions, to verify that they are peaceful and without ill or unwise intent. Please for a moment remain here," it says, and walks away.|271|0
units.english: "Happy this one is that you agree to that condition. Bear in mind, Captain, that the slightest misstep may have grave consequences." The Quarg stares you down. "We will be watching your actions, to verify that they are peaceful and without ill or unwise intent. Please for a moment remain here," it says, and walks away.
units.italian: "Felice è questo uno che tu accetti quella condizione. Tieni presente, capitano, che il minimo passo falso può avere conseguenze gravi." Il Quarg ti fissa. "Osserveremo le tue azioni, per verificare che siano pacifiche e senza intenti malvagi o imprudenti. Resta qui per un momento, ti prego", dice, e si allontana.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	The Quarg only takes a moment to come back, now carrying a sleek silver box with a display on one side. "This is our translator, our link to the Incipias. It is able to translate their unusual language into your speech as well. Be aware of the honor of this one gifting this to you," it says.|272|0
units.english: The Quarg only takes a moment to come back, now carrying a sleek silver box with a display on one side. "This is our translator, our link to the Incipias. It is able to translate their unusual language into your speech as well. Be aware of the honor of this one gifting this to you," it says.
units.italian: Il Quarg torna dopo un attimo, portando ora una scatola d'argento levigata con un display su un lato. "Questo è il nostro traduttore, il nostro legame con gli Incipias. È in grado di tradurre la loro lingua inconsueta nella tua parlata. Sappi dell'onore che questo uno ti fa donandotelo", dice.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	As you stow it away, the Quarg speaks once more. "To satisfactorily utilize this device, you must direct it towards the source of the communication, so that it is made able to discern the relevant emissions. Given the complexity of their language, the translator might not be able to adequately translate some aspects of their obscure speech."|273|0
units.english: As you stow it away, the Quarg speaks once more. "To satisfactorily utilize this device, you must direct it towards the source of the communication, so that it is made able to discern the relevant emissions. Given the complexity of their language, the translator might not be able to adequately translate some aspects of their obscure speech."
units.italian: Mentre lo riponi, il Quarg parla ancora. "Per usare adeguatamente questo dispositivo, devi puntarlo verso la fonte della comunicazione, così che sia in grado di discernere le emissioni rilevanti. Data la complessità della loro lingua, il traduttore potrebbe non riuscire a rendere adeguatamente alcuni aspetti del loro parlato oscuro."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	It then looks you directly in the eyes. "Remember what has been told, human. The stars have no place for those who would act foolishly and thoughtlessly towards their fellow beings." The Quarg then walks away, leaving you alone.|274|0
units.english: It then looks you directly in the eyes. "Remember what has been told, human. The stars have no place for those who would act foolishly and thoughtlessly towards their fellow beings." The Quarg then walks away, leaving you alone.
units.italian: Poi ti guarda dritto negli occhi. "Ricorda ciò che ti è stato detto, umano. Le stelle non hanno posto per chi agirebbe in modo sciocco e sconsiderato verso i propri simili." Il Quarg se ne va, lasciandoti solo.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"It is perhaps a laborious task for an adolescent species such as yourself to comprehend our ways, but we must place the continuation of species above the existence of individuals. If we reveal ourselves to them at this inopportune moment, the shock of such an advanced species appearing in their space will fan the flames of chaos."|277|0
units.english: "It is perhaps a laborious task for an adolescent species such as yourself to comprehend our ways, but we must place the continuation of species above the existence of individuals. If we reveal ourselves to them at this inopportune moment, the shock of such an advanced species appearing in their space will fan the flames of chaos."
units.italian: "È forse un compito laborioso per una specie adolescente come la tua comprendere i nostri modi, ma dobbiamo porre la continuazione delle specie al di sopra dell'esistenza dei singoli. Se ci rivelassimo a loro in questo momento inopportuno, lo shock di una specie così avanzata che appare nel loro spazio alimenterebbe le fiamme del caos."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"Then let me help them."|279|0
units.english: "Then let me help them."
units.italian: "Allora lascia che li aiuti."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"You can deal with the consequences later. Help them now!"|281|0
units.english: "You can deal with the consequences later. Help them now!"
units.italian: "Puoi affrontare le conseguenze dopo. Aiutali ora!"

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	The Quarg takes on a sour look. "Insisting you are. Understand that our own intervention is out of the question." It sighs. "However, this one can foresee the likelihood of you making a rash and impetuous decision to contact these Incipias further."|282|0
units.english: The Quarg takes on a sour look. "Insisting you are. Understand that our own intervention is out of the question." It sighs. "However, this one can foresee the likelihood of you making a rash and impetuous decision to contact these Incipias further."
units.italian: Il Quarg assume un'espressione acida. "Insisti. Sappi che un nostro intervento è fuori discussione." Sospira. "Tuttavia, questo uno può prevedere la probabilità che tu prenda una decisione avventata e impetuosa di contattare ancora questi Incipias."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"Sure. Let me do the work."|284|0
units.english: "Sure. Let me do the work."
units.italian: "Certo. Lascia che faccia il lavoro."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"If you insist on not helping..."|285|0
units.english: "If you insist on not helping..."
units.italian: "Se insisti a non aiutarli..."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	The Quarg rapidly clicks its teeth before continuing.|286|0
units.english: The Quarg rapidly clicks its teeth before continuing.
units.italian: Il Quarg batte rapidamente i denti prima di continuare.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"We are gracious for your understanding, but remember thus: the Incipias are under our watch and care. None shall come to harm them without incurring our wrath." With these words the Quarg turns away.|289|0
units.english: "We are gracious for your understanding, but remember thus: the Incipias are under our watch and care. None shall come to harm them without incurring our wrath." With these words the Quarg turns away.
units.italian: "Ti siamo grati per la comprensione, ma ricorda questo: gli Incipias sono sotto la nostra vigilanza e la nostra cura. Nessuno li danneggerà senza incorrere nella nostra ira." Con queste parole il Quarg si volta.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|After you enter the system, you prepare to broadcast your first message with the Quarg's translator.|294|0
units.english: After you enter the system, you prepare to broadcast your first message with the Quarg's translator.
units.italian: Dopo che sei entrato nel sistema, ti prepari a trasmettere il tuo primo messaggio con il traduttore dei Quarg.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"Hello. I am Captain <first> <last>, here to make contact."|296|0
units.english: "Hello. I am Captain <first> <last>, here to make contact."
units.italian: "Salve. Sono il capitano <first> <last>, qui per stabilire un contatto."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"Greetings, strangers. I seek to help you."|297|0
units.english: "Greetings, strangers. I seek to help you."
units.italian: "Vi saluto, stranieri. Cerco di aiutarvi."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"I come in peace."|298|0
units.english: "I come in peace."
units.italian: "Vengo in pace."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	You notice that the translator starts to flash a sequence of lights, and you point it towards your ship's communication device. For a minute, nothing happens at all.|299|0
units.english: You notice that the translator starts to flash a sequence of lights, and you point it towards your ship's communication device. For a minute, nothing happens at all.
units.italian: Noti che il traduttore inizia a lampeggiare in una sequenza di luci, e lo punti verso il dispositivo di comunicazione della tua nave. Per un minuto non succede assolutamente nulla.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	After some time, a wave of movement passes through all ships in the system, and a communication channel opens from the space station. Colors rush over your display: a mix of yellow and green. You point your translator towards the flashing lights and hope it is able to pick up whatever these aliens are saying to you.|300|0
units.english: After some time, a wave of movement passes through all ships in the system, and a communication channel opens from the space station. Colors rush over your display: a mix of yellow and green. You point your translator towards the flashing lights and hope it is able to pick up whatever these aliens are saying to you.
units.italian: Dopo qualche tempo, un'onda di movimento attraversa tutte le navi del sistema, e dalla stazione spaziale si apre un canale di comunicazione. Colori si riversano sul tuo display: un misto di giallo e verde. Punti il traduttore verso le luci lampeggianti e speri che riesca a captare qualunque cosa ti stiano dicendo questi alieni.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"Welcome world-traveler. We greet you in our home-space." The voice is smooth and synthetic, lacking in any discernible emotion. The colors stop before rushing over your screen again. "What is your intention-goal here?"|301|0
units.english: "Welcome world-traveler. We greet you in our home-space." The voice is smooth and synthetic, lacking in any discernible emotion. The colors stop before rushing over your screen again. "What is your intention-goal here?"
units.italian: "Benvenuto, viaggiatore-di-mondi. Ti salutiamo nel nostro spazio-casa." La voce è levigata e sintetica, priva di qualsiasi emozione discernibile. I colori si fermano prima di riversarsi di nuovo sul tuo schermo. "Qual è la tua intenzione-scopo qui?"

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"I am here to make peaceful contact with you."|303|0
units.english: "I am here to make peaceful contact with you."
units.italian: "Sono qui per stabilire un contatto pacifico con voi."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"I want to help one of your stranded ships."|304|0
units.english: "I want to help one of your stranded ships."
units.italian: "Voglio aiutare una delle vostre navi bloccate."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	Again a long pause. "Your intention-goals are welcome. Please dock to the capital-station." Along the message comes a small map of the station with the docking ports highlighted.|305|0
units.english: Again a long pause. "Your intention-goals are welcome. Please dock to the capital-station." Along the message comes a small map of the station with the docking ports highlighted.
units.italian: Ancora una lunga pausa. "Le tue intenzioni-scopo sono benvenute. Attracca alla stazione-capitale." Insieme al messaggio arriva una piccola mappa della stazione con i portelli di attracco evidenziati.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|log|307|0
units.english: Met with the Incipias on their space station, and gained access to their ships, which are capable of entering the gas giant that the stranded Incipias ship has taken refuge in.
units.italian: Incontrati gli Incipias sulla loro stazione spaziale, e ottenuto l'accesso alle loro navi, capaci di entrare nel gigante gassoso in cui si è rifugiata la nave Incipias bloccata.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|log|308|0
units.english: The Incipias are a species of aliens that live to the northeast of Hai space. They originated from a gas giant, and resemble large, floating octopi. As they have not yet developed the hyperdrive, they are confined to a single system and are under the protection of the Quarg.
units.italian: Gli Incipias sono una specie di alieni che vive a nord-est dello spazio degli Hai. Provengono da un gigante gassoso e somigliano a grandi polpi fluttuanti. Non avendo ancora sviluppato l'iperguida, sono confinati a un solo sistema e sono sotto la protezione dei Quarg.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|Thanks to the map, you are easily able to dock with the station. Your airlock opens and you enter an environment like nothing you've ever seen before. There are no hallways like you would see in a human space station - instead, tubes full of fog, some of which even ascend vertically, appear to be the only way of getting around. A crowd of beings gather in front of your airlock, each flashing a multitude of colors. A group of five floats in front of the crowd, and you finally get a good look at the creatures. They are large, about three meters tall, with a bulbous section at the top covered in scale-like structures. Near the base of the bulb, three large eyes are arranged in a shallow arc, below which there are eight undulating, dexterous-looking tentacles. The Incipias in the middle of the group starts pulsating in calm tones.|310|0
units.english: Thanks to the map, you are easily able to dock with the station. Your airlock opens and you enter an environment like nothing you've ever seen before. There are no hallways like you would see in a human space station - instead, tubes full of fog, some of which even ascend vertically, appear to be the only way of getting around. A crowd of beings gather in front of your airlock, each flashing a multitude of colors. A group of five floats in front of the crowd, and you finally get a good look at the creatures. They are large, about three meters tall, with a bulbous section at the top covered in scale-like structures. Near the base of the bulb, three large eyes are arranged in a shallow arc, below which there are eight undulating, dexterous-looking tentacles. The Incipias in the middle of the group starts pulsating in calm tones.
units.italian: Grazie alla mappa, riesci ad attraccare facilmente alla stazione. Il portello si apre ed entri in un ambiente come niente che tu abbia mai visto. Non ci sono corridoi come in una stazione spaziale umana: al loro posto, tubi pieni di nebbia, alcuni dei quali salgono persino in verticale, sembrano l'unico modo per spostarsi. Una folla di esseri si raduna davanti al tuo portello, ognuno che lampeggia di una moltitudine di colori. Un gruppo di cinque fluttua davanti alla folla, e finalmente vedi bene le creature. Sono grandi, circa tre metri, con una sezione bulbosa in cima coperta di strutture simili a scaglie. Vicino alla base del bulbo, tre grandi occhi sono disposti in un arco poco profondo, sotto i quali ci sono otto tentacoli ondulanti dall'aria abile. Gli Incipias al centro del gruppo iniziano a pulsare di toni calmi.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"Welcome, outer-being, to our capital. We are the Incipias." It stops as if awaiting an answer. The light seems to radiate from the scales covering it, but you are unable to tell whether they produce it or if it is simply reflected.|311|0
units.english: "Welcome, outer-being, to our capital. We are the Incipias." It stops as if awaiting an answer. The light seems to radiate from the scales covering it, but you are unable to tell whether they produce it or if it is simply reflected.
units.italian: "Benvenuto, essere-esterno, nella nostra capitale. Siamo gli Incipias." Si ferma come aspettando una risposta. La luce sembra irradiarsi dalle scaglie che lo coprono, ma non riesci a dire se la producano o se sia semplicemente riflessa.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"Greetings, Incipias. I am a human."|313|0
units.english: "Greetings, Incipias. I am a human."
units.italian: "Vi saluto, Incipias. Sono un umano."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"I thank you for your hospitality."|314|0
units.english: "I thank you for your hospitality."
units.italian: "Vi ringrazio per l'ospitalità."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	Your translator begins rapidly flashing. The Incipias seem to respond to this - movement and colors begin to diffuse through the crowd like waves.|315|0
units.english: Your translator begins rapidly flashing. The Incipias seem to respond to this - movement and colors begin to diffuse through the crowd like waves.
units.italian: Il tuo traduttore inizia a lampeggiare rapidamente. Gli Incipias sembrano reagire: movimento e colori cominciano a diffondersi tra la folla come onde.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	The "speaker" continues. "You are the first outer-being that ever communicated with us. Are you the only outer-being out there?"|316|0
units.english: The "speaker" continues. "You are the first outer-being that ever communicated with us. Are you the only outer-being out there?"
units.italian: Il "portavoce" continua. "Sei il primo essere-esterno che abbia mai comunicato con noi. Sei l'unico essere-esterno là fuori?"

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"No, there are others too."|318|0
units.english: "No, there are others too."
units.italian: "No, ci sono anche altri."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"The galaxy is full of other beings."|319|0
units.english: "The galaxy is full of other beings."
units.italian: "La galassia è piena di altri esseri."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	Another wave goes through the crowd. "So there are more. But, far-stranger, how can we help you?"|320|0
units.english: Another wave goes through the crowd. "So there are more. But, far-stranger, how can we help you?"
units.italian: Un'altra onda attraversa la folla. "Dunque ce ne sono altri. Ma, straniero-lontano, come possiamo aiutarti?"

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	(Tell them about the stranded ship and how I want to help them.)|322|0
units.english: (Tell them about the stranded ship and how I want to help them.)
units.italian: (Racconta della nave bloccata e di come voglio aiutarli.)

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"I want one of your ships."|324|0
units.english: "I want one of your ships."
units.italian: "Voglio una delle vostre navi."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"We shall allow you to buy one, if that is all that it takes to make you a not-danger. Please excuse us. We need to talk about what this new situation-opportunity means for our species. I hope we can out-question you more another time."|325|0
units.english: "We shall allow you to buy one, if that is all that it takes to make you a not-danger. Please excuse us. We need to talk about what this new situation-opportunity means for our species. I hope we can out-question you more another time."
units.italian: "Ti permetteremo di comprarne una, se è tutto ciò che serve a renderti un non-pericolo. Perdonaci. Dobbiamo parlare di cosa significhi questa situazione-opportunità per la nostra specie. Speriamo di poter interrogare-oltre voi in un'altra occasione."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	Another wave goes through the crowd, but this time you notice an overflow in green tones.|328|0
units.english: Another wave goes through the crowd, but this time you notice an overflow in green tones.
units.italian: Un'altra onda attraversa la folla, ma questa volta noti un eccesso di toni verdi.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"So they are still alive. We shall give you access to our ships, so that you may enter the air-planet they have taken refuge in. Do note though that they cannot jump between system-places, not like your own ship. We hope to question you more on another future-time."|329|0
units.english: "So they are still alive. We shall give you access to our ships, so that you may enter the air-planet they have taken refuge in. Do note though that they cannot jump between system-places, not like your own ship. We hope to question you more on another future-time."
units.italian: "Dunque sono ancora vivi. Ti daremo accesso alle nostre navi, così che tu possa entrare nel pianeta-d'aria in cui si sono rifugiati. Nota però che non possono saltare tra luoghi-sistema, non come la tua nave. Speriamo di poterti interrogare-oltre in un futuro-tempo."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	The five float away but the crowd continues staring at you, probably out of interest.|331|0
units.english: The five float away but the crowd continues staring at you, probably out of interest.
units.italian: I cinque fluttuano via, ma la folla continua a fissarti, probabilmente per interesse.
